database_summary: Small multi-domain SQLite catalog combining hardware (products, customers, monthly sales, costs, prices, pre-invoice deductions), a web analytics/sales sample (accounts, orders, events, reps, regions), a university sample (students, faculty, offerings, enrollment, courses), a few miscellaneous tables (StaffHours, SalaryDataset). The schema mixes descriptive/master/dimension tables, large fact-like monthly sales and web event/order activity, and small reference lists. Key analytical measures exist in hardware_fact_sales_monthly, hardware_fact_gross_price, hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost, hardware_fact_pre_invoice_deductions and web_orders. Many dimension tables are small and static.

accepted.name: hardware_customer_dim_clean
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_code,
  customer,
  platform,
  channel,
  market,
  sub_zone,
  region
FROM hardware_dim_customer
accepted.description: Normalized/passthrough view of hardware_dim_customer exposing one row per customer_code with cleaned textual attributes. Use when joining customer descriptive attributes to facts. | Use for: Join customers to sales or price facts; Aggregate sales by market/region/platform/channel; Filter customers by region/market for cohorts

accepted.name: hardware_product_dim_clean
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  division,
  segment,
  category,
  product,
  variant
FROM hardware_dim_product
accepted.description: Normalized/passthrough view of hardware_dim_product exposing product descriptive attributes. Use when joining product attributes to facts. | Use for: Join products to sales/cost/price facts; Aggregate sales by category/segment/division; Filter product lists by variant or category

accepted.name: hardware_sales_monthly_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  date,
  product_code,
  customer_code,
  sold_quantity,
  fiscal_year
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
accepted.description: Canonical monthly sales fact rows parsed as month-grain. Keeps product_code, customer_code, date and sold_quantity and fiscal_year. Use as base for aggregations and joins. | Use for: Monthly sales trends by product/customer; Join to product/customer dims and price/cost facts; Aggregate sold_quantity by time/product/customer

accepted.name: hardware_gross_price_by_product_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  fiscal_year,
  gross_price
FROM hardware_fact_gross_price
accepted.description: Year-grain gross price per product. Use to join year-aligned price information to sales or cost facts. | Use for: Compute revenue using gross_price x quantity; Compare price changes across fiscal_years; Join price to sales aggregated by fiscal_year

accepted.name: hardware_manufacturing_cost_by_product_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  cost_year,
  manufacturing_cost
FROM hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost
accepted.description: Year-grain manufacturing cost per product (cost_year). Use to compute gross margin when aligned to the same year as sales/prices. | Use for: Compute cost-per-unit and margins by product and year; Join manufacturing_cost to sales/prices after aligning year columns

accepted.name: hardware_pre_invoice_deductions_by_customer_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_code,
  fiscal_year,
  pre_invoice_discount_pct
FROM hardware_fact_pre_invoice_deductions
accepted.description: Customer-year pre-invoice discount percentage. Use to adjust revenue or compute net price at customer-year grain. | Use for: Adjust revenue by customer discounts; Analyze discount_pct distribution across customers/years

accepted.name: web_accounts_with_rep_and_region
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.id,
  a.name,
  a.website,
  a.lat,
  a.long,
  a.primary_poc,
  a.sales_rep_id,
  r.id AS region_id,
  r.name AS region_name,
  s.id AS sales_rep_id_preserved,
  s.name AS sales_rep_name,
  s.region_id AS sales_rep_region_id
FROM web_accounts a
LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps s ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
LEFT JOIN web_region r ON s.region_id = r.id
accepted.description: Denormalized account dimension joining web_accounts -> web_sales_reps -> web_region to expose account attributes plus sales rep name and region name. Use for account-level reporting and joining to orders/events. | Use for: Account-level dashboards by sales rep or region; Join accounts to orders/events for spatial or rep analysis

accepted.name: web_orders_with_account_and_reps
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.id,
  o.account_id,
  o.occurred_at,
  o.standard_qty,
  o.gloss_qty,
  o.poster_qty,
  o.total,
  o.standard_amt_usd,
  o.gloss_amt_usd,
  o.poster_amt_usd,
  o.total_amt_usd,
  a.name AS name,
  a.website AS website,
  a.lat AS lat,
  a.long AS long,
  a.primary_poc AS primary_poc,
  a.sales_rep_id AS sales_rep_id
FROM web_orders o
LEFT JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
accepted.description: Order-level fact joined to account and sales rep info. Preserves order id, account_id and occurred_at plus quantity and amount measures to support downstream aggregations. | Use for: Order revenue and quantity trends by account or sales rep; Spatial analysis of orders using lat/long; Time-series analysis of order amounts

accepted.name: monthly_sales_by_product_customer_year
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_code,
  customer_code,
  fiscal_year,
  SUM(sold_quantity) AS total_sold_quantity
FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
GROUP BY product_code, customer_code, fiscal_year
accepted.description: Aggregated sold_quantity by product_code, customer_code and fiscal_year. Useful for yearly summaries, joining to year-grain prices/costs/discounts. | Use for: Yearly sales volume per product and customer; Compute revenue by joining to gross_price and applying discounts; Identify high-volume product-customer pairs

accepted.name: product_year_revenue_cost_margin
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.product_code,
  s.fiscal_year,
  SUM(s.total_sold_quantity) AS total_sold_quantity,
  p.gross_price AS gross_price,
  c.manufacturing_cost AS manufacturing_cost,
  SUM(s.total_sold_quantity) * p.gross_price AS revenue,
  SUM(s.total_sold_quantity) * c.manufacturing_cost AS total_manufacturing_cost,
  (SUM(s.total_sold_quantity) * p.gross_price) - (SUM(s.total_sold_quantity) * c.manufacturing_cost) AS gross_margin
FROM (
  SELECT product_code, fiscal_year, SUM(sold_quantity) AS total_sold_quantity
  FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly
  GROUP BY product_code, fiscal_year
) s
LEFT JOIN hardware_fact_gross_price p ON s.product_code = p.product_code AND s.fiscal_year = p.fiscal_year
LEFT JOIN hardware_fact_manufacturing_cost c ON s.product_code = c.product_code AND s.fiscal_year = c.cost_year
GROUP BY s.product_code, s.fiscal_year, p.gross_price, c.manufacturing_cost
accepted.description: Year-grain per-product aggregates joining sales (quantity), gross_price and manufacturing_cost to compute derived measures: revenue, cost, gross_margin. Useful for margin analysis by product and year. | Use for: Product-level revenue and margin analysis by year; Identify products with negative margins or rising costs; Compare price vs cost trends over years

accepted.name: accounts_event_counts_by_account_day
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  date(substr(occurred_at,1,10)) AS event_date,
  COUNT(*) AS events_per_day
FROM web_events
GROUP BY account_id, date(substr(occurred_at,1,10))
accepted.description: Daily event counts per account from web_events. Useful for activity/time-series analyses and joining to account attributes. | Use for: Daily engagement metrics per account; Correlate events with orders or campaigns; Detect activity spikes per account

accepted.name: staffhours_enter_exit_sequence
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  StaffMember,
  EventDate,
  EventTime,
  EventType,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY StaffMember, EventDate ORDER BY EventTime) AS event_seq
FROM StaffHours
accepted.description: Orders StaffHours events per StaffMember and EventDate by EventTime, assigns a sequence number. Useful to pair enter/exit events, compute durations, or detect missing events. | Use for: Compute time-in-office by pairing Enter/Exit events; Detect missing Enter/Exit events for a staff member/day; Sequence events to build session windows

accepted.name: students_with_enrollment_and_gpa
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  st.StdNo,
  st.StdFirstName,
  st.StdLastName,
  st.StdCity,
  st.StdState,
  st.StdZip,
  st.StdMajor,
  st.StdClass,
  st.StdGPA,
  COUNT(e.OfferNo) AS enrollment_count,
  AVG(e.EnrGrade) AS avg_enrollment_grade
FROM university_student st
LEFT JOIN university_enrollment e ON st.StdNo = e.StdNo
GROUP BY st.StdNo, st.StdFirstName, st.StdLastName, st.StdCity, st.StdState, st.StdZip, st.StdMajor, st.StdClass, st.StdGPA
accepted.description: Denormalized student-level view joining student master data with enrollment aggregates (count of offers and average EnrGrade / StdGPA). Useful for student performance/cohort analyses. | Use for: Student performance by major/class; Identify students with many enrollments or low avg grades; Cohort analysis combining demographic and grade metrics

accepted.name: faculty_with_offerings_count
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.FacNo,
  f.FacFirstName,
  f.FacLastName,
  f.FacDept,
  f.FacRank,
  f.FacCity,
  f.FacState,
  COUNT(o.OfferNo) AS offerings_count,
  MIN(o.OffYear) AS first_offering_year,
  MAX(o.OffYear) AS last_offering_year
FROM university_faculty f
LEFT JOIN university_offering o ON f.FacNo = o.FacNo
GROUP BY f.FacNo, f.FacFirstName, f.FacLastName, f.FacDept, f.FacRank, f.FacCity, f.FacState
accepted.description: Faculty-level aggregation that counts course offerings taught by each faculty (FacNo). Useful for workload and teaching activity analysis. | Use for: Faculty teaching loads and tenure of teaching; Identify inactive faculty with zero offerings; Correlate faculty rank with number of offerings

accepted.name: course_catalog_clean
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  CourseNo,
  CrsDesc,
  CrsUnits
FROM university_course
accepted.description: Pass-through view of university_course exposing course metadata (CourseNo, CrsDesc, CrsUnits). Use when joining course attributes to offerings or enrollments. | Use for: Join offerings/enrollments to course descriptions and unit counts; Aggregate enrollments by course units or course description
